rule: round3: overshoot objective, C1 loss <= stock x 1.05, C2 Q2 gate peak <= stock, every alternative; selection gated on the reproduction control and the half-step check
scope: ranking within the unvalidated model (EPC2302 Fig. 7 exception, behavioural driver, exploratory G extraction); provisional simulation predictions, not a frozen prediction record and not validated values
